in_hindi.name: Aveesha
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Knowledge, Wisdom, Intellect
in_hindi.long_meaning: Aveesha एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Aveesha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vijñāna’, which means ‘knowledge’. This name is associated with wisdom, intellect, and learning. In Hindu mythology, Aveesha is also believed to be a manifestation of the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, and art.
